title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] At Last, the Final Battle!

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】いざラストバトル！
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] At Last, the Final Battle!

blocks.source: 前回の記事がRPG制作講座だったせいで、微妙に久々の開発記録です。終盤の画面を載せるような非常識なことはできませんので、今回のスクショは記事の内容に関係ない適当なものです。中盤以降はあまりネタをバラしたくないので、出せるものも尽きてきました……。
blocks.translation: Since my previous article was an RPG Design Guide, this is a somewhat long-awaited Development Log. I can't do something as outrageous as showing screens from the latter part of the game, so this time's screenshots are random ones unrelated to the article's content. I don't want to give away too much from the middle onward, so I'm running out of things I can show……

blocks.source: 手書きした城のグラフィックが微妙だったので、ツクール２００３のものを持ってきて色調整してみたら、だいぶマシになった気がします。
blocks.translation: The castle graphic I drew by hand was rather mediocre, so I brought over the one from RPG Maker 2003 and tried adjusting its colors. I feel like it turned out much better.

blocks.source: ２００３はバグと仕様の微妙さでロクに使わなかったので、これぐらいは活用しないと。
blocks.translation: I barely used 2003 because of its bugs and awkward specifications, so I have to at least make use of it this much.

blocks.source: そろそろ、顔グラとかも上がったスキルで描き直したいですね。中には未だにデザインが確定していないキャラもいたりします。「いつでも直せるし～」というわけで放置していました。スクショに出てこないキャラがいますが、ちゃんと他にもいるのでご安心を。
blocks.translation: I'd like to redraw things like the face graphics with my improved skills soon. Some characters still don't even have finalized designs. I left them alone thinking, “I can always fix them later~.” There are characters who haven't appeared in the screenshots, but rest assured, there are plenty of others as well.

blocks.source: ついにテストプレイがラストダンジョンに到達しました！ ラスボス～エンディングを調整中です。作者のクリア時間基準で２０～２５時間といったところでしょうか。
blocks.translation: At last, the test playthrough has reached the final dungeon! I'm currently fine-tuning the final boss through the ending. Based on the author's clear time, it takes around 20–25 hours.

blocks.source: もっとも、このゲームはテンポが速い分、操作時間の比重が大きくなります。ストーリーも戦闘も「見てるだけ～」というシーンはそんなにありません。なので、プレイヤーの操作速度やプレイスタイルでも結構変わってくると思います。
blocks.translation: That said, because this game has a fast pace, time spent controlling it makes up a larger proportion. There aren't that many scenes in either the story or battles where you're just “watching~.” So I think the total can vary considerably depending on the player's operating speed and play style.

blocks.source: ※まだ色々と調整するつもりですし、テストプレイも二周目三周目を考えていますので、もう数ヶ月完成にはかかります。
blocks.translation: ※I still plan to make various adjustments, and I'm considering second and third test playthroughs, so it will take a few more months to complete.

blocks.source: さて、相変わらず僕の作品はラスボスが強めです。昨今のラスボス戦はイベント性重視だったり、クリア後の裏ボスの前座扱いだったりで、微妙な強さにされていることも珍しくありませんが、嘆かわしいことです。そんな風潮には流されません。
blocks.translation: Now then, as always, the final boss in my games is fairly strong. These days, final boss battles are often focused on spectacle or treated as a prelude to a superboss after clearing the game, so it's not uncommon for them to be given rather mediocre strength. I find that lamentable. I won't be swayed by that trend.

blocks.source: 長いストーリーを締めくくる最後の敵
blocks.translation: The final enemy that brings a long story to a close

blocks.source: ゲームシステムの粋を結集した最強の敵
blocks.translation: The strongest enemy, embodying the very best of the game system

blocks.source: 最高の戦闘演出＆音楽
blocks.translation: The finest battle presentation and music

blocks.source: これらが合わさることこそがラストバトルの醍醐味です。ストーリーとゲームデザインと演出が頂点で交わる瞬間。まさに総合芸術たるゲームにしか成し得ない奇跡といっても過言ではないでしょう。
blocks.translation: The combination of these things is what makes the final battle so special. It is the moment when the story, game design, and presentation intersect at their peak. It would not be an exaggeration to call it a miracle that only a game, truly a comprehensive art form, can achieve.

blocks.source: ……無駄にテンションが高い文章になりましたが、なんとなく僕のラストバトルに対する考えがわかって頂けたでしょうか？
blocks.translation: ……This turned into an unnecessarily overexcited piece of writing, but I hope you've gained some idea of how I feel about final battles?

blocks.source: 僕がクリア後の裏ボスの類を作らない理由もこれが一つです。ラストバトルが一番面白くなるようにゲーム全体の設計をしているので、その後を作るのがしんどいのです。
blocks.translation: This is also one reason I don't create superbosses or the like after clearing the game. I design the entire game so that the final battle will be the most enjoyable part, so creating what comes after it is difficult for me.

blocks.source: 漫画でいうとスラムダンク。作者は作中最高の試合を描いた後で「これより面白い試合は描けない」とトーナメントの途中でも連載を終えましたが、それと似たような心理だと思います。
blocks.translation: In terms of manga, think Slam Dunk. After drawing the best game in the series, the author ended the serialization partway through the tournament, saying, “I can't draw a game more interesting than this.” I think my feelings are somewhat similar.

blocks.source: 僕としては、裏ボスを作るためにラスボスを加減して作るということは、やりたくありません。やっぱりラストバトルは全力を尽くして制作したい。全力を尽くして制作した以上はそこをストーリー上もゲーム上もクライマックスにしたいなと。
blocks.translation: I don't want to hold back when creating the final boss just so I can make a superboss afterward. I want to give the final battle my all. And having put my all into creating it, I want to make it the climax of both the story and the game.

blocks.source: 制作者としてもそうですが、一プレイヤーとしても『クリア後』が充実した作品をやると、しまりがなく冗長な印象を持つことが多いのですよね。
blocks.translation: That applies to me as a creator, but even as a player, when I play a work with substantial post-game content, I often find it feels loose and drawn out.

blocks.source: 「そう思うならクリア後は手を付けなければよい」という制作者もいるでしょうが、「出された料理は全部食べようとする」「本は最後のページまで読もうとする」というのが人間心理。クリア後に「重要なイベントがある作品」もあれば「単にラスボスより強い敵がいるだけの作品」もあって、「どこでやめるか」という見極めはなかなか難しいのです。
blocks.translation: There may be creators who say, “If you feel that way, just don't touch the post-game content,” but human nature is to “try to eat all the food that's been served” and “try to read a book through to the last page.” Some works have “important events” after clearing the game, while others “simply have enemies stronger than the final boss,” making it rather difficult to judge “where to stop.”

blocks.source: もちろん色んなやり方があってもよいとは思うのですが、そんなわけで自分としてはラストバトル～エンディングでゲームを終えるというのが理想的だと思っています。
blocks.translation: Of course, I think it's fine to approach things in many different ways, but for that reason, I personally feel that ending the game with the final battle through the ending is ideal.

blocks.source: 僕もかれこれ、Ｗｅｂ上にＲＰＧの公開を初めて１０年超となります。
blocks.translation: It has been over ten years since I first began publishing RPGs online.

blocks.source: 仕事に忙殺されて随分とブランクが空きましたが……。
blocks.translation: I was consumed by work and ended up taking a considerably long break, though……

blocks.source: 作品を公開する度に、クリア後の隠しボスを求める声は結構多いということは承知しています。それでも、ここは個人的には譲れないところなのです。
blocks.translation: I know that every time I release a work, quite a lot of people ask for a hidden boss after clearing the game. Even so, this is one point I personally cannot compromise on.

blocks.source: こんな感じで、作者と一部ユーザの意見がぶつかった場合は基本的に作者の意見を優先しちゃってよいと思っています。妥協点があるなら狙ってもよいでしょうが、八方美人が好かれるとも世の中限りません。それだったら、無理せず自分と感性が近いユーザを照準に合わせておくのもありだと思うのです。
blocks.translation: When the creator's opinions clash with those of some users like this, I think it's basically fine to prioritize the creator's opinions. If there's a point of compromise, it may be worth aiming for, but being all things to all people is not always well received. In that case, I think it's also fine to target users whose sensibilities are close to one's own, without forcing oneself.

blocks.source: ……何だかまた開発記録というよりも講座＆コラムな内容になってしまいました。が、今回は個人的な意見の比重がいつも以上に多いのでここに置いておきます。その内、編集して講座に移すかもしれませんけど。
blocks.translation: ……Somehow, this has once again turned into content more like a guide and column than a Development Log. However, this time it contains much more personal opinion than usual, so I'll leave it here. I may edit it and move it to the guides someday, though.

blocks.source: これで今年の開発１１７０時間経過です。
blocks.translation: With this, I've reached 1,170 hours of development work this year.
